title: PGP-1.02 memev: the project store, state machine and coordinator wired into the daemon, with a licence-boundary guard
request: Per-pull-request contract for memev, branch feat/wire-project-engine (pull request #326, checks green; it implements SO-1.01 and closes this contract's T1 to T3). Proposed and unsigned; the signer (ASTL workstream) signs after the red-team gate. Repository: memev. It implements the decisions of contract SO-1.01 (canonical execution integration, signed 31 Oct 2026, design-record stage) and does not restate them: SO-1.01 asks for the decision record, this contract asks for the code that follows it. Programme tasks covered: WP07-01, WP07-02, WP07-03 and WP15-01; WP07-04 stays in PG-07.1. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository (BSL 1.1 with its PATENTS file) and is reached only across the call-out boundary, never vendored, so inclusion cannot relicense it; tiers are the free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that, with no Federated tier and no separate Personal trial; federation is planned, not available. The SO-1.01 design record (docs/scope-one/design/canonical-execution-integration.md) is that contract's deliverable, owned by the ASTL workstream, and is referenced here, not written or edited. T4 lists the wiring that pull request #326 leaves open. Depends on contracts: SO-1.01, SO-04-A, SO-07-A, SO-08-A, SR-1.27, SR-1.30.

requirements: SO-1.01 requirement 1: the project store is the durable authority for project entities and append-only events (source: contract SO-1.01 T1)
